recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a heavily tattooed man holding a sleeping infant against his chest, featuring centered, wide-spaced serif typography overlaid across the mid-section.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's downward gaze creates a protective arc over the sleeping child.
The intricate detail of the tattoos contrasts with the smooth skin of the infant.
The stark white text cuts horizontally across the dark, textured foreground of the subjects.
A soft vignette focuses light on the faces while darkening the lower extremities.
coreInvariants: Wide letter-spacing in the display text
Side-profile orientation of the adult subject
Visible skin textures and tattoo ink depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subjects are centrally framed, filling approximately 80% of the vertical space in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The adult's closed eye and the child's face form the emotional and visual center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the man's head down to the child, then moves horizontally along the typographic line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper corners and background to isolate the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin and background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks for tattoo ink and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typography and highlights on jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the text and the underlying skin tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyph forms used for maximum legibility

composition.relationshipToImage: Provides a structural horizontal break against the organic curves of the bodies

treatment.shadow: Subtle soft drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in isolation to maintain minimalist focus.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif structure with high legibility
For a more high-fashion, high-contrast look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a man with intricate tattoos holding a sleeping baby. Lighting should be soft from the top-left, creating deep shadows. Background is a neutral gray gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered uppercase text in a white serif font across the middle of the image. Increase letter-spacing significantly so the word spans the width of the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to create a rhythmic horizontal line?
Is the image strictly monochrome without color cast?

Specific facial features of the individuals
